execution.incomplete_case: Jev B, kroB200 replicate 1, HTTP 520 on its first model call after two forced candidate steps; no retry.
execution.independent_verification: All new terminal logs replayed; independent direct-double-sqrt objective, exhaustive proposal formula minima, exact request/city mapping, probability audit and frozen source/input seals passed.

rules.definitions: c is the current city, U is ALL unvisited cities, s=0. e=d(c,v), h=min(d(v,w) for w in U excluding v), r=d(v,s). Each rule proposes its minimum-score city over all U; ties use lowest city ID. Rules with identical proposed cities are grouped into a single action.
rules.hyperparameters: Integer coefficients fixed at e, e+h, 2e-r, e-h; no fitting.

arms.A: Reused verified-main-v3 all legal cities; complete tsp225 replacements only.
arms.B: Anonymous deduplicated proposal cities; full graph and shared candidate numeric features.
arms.C: Same deduplicated proposals/order/features at same history, plus rule semantics and mapping.

analysis.inclusion: Recommend appendix diagnostic if independent verification passes and every model/arm coverage>=95%; otherwise archive as incomplete. Performance-improvement language additionally requires >=1pp graph-macro gain and >=5/7 graph directions, with all models/contrasts disclosed. No automatic main-paper edits.
analysis.missing: No imputation or success-only denominator. Paired gaps use jointly completed same conditions and report counts; graph summaries flag missing conditions.
analysis.primary: Per-model C-B paired percentage-point gap delta, graph-macro; negative is better. All scheduled coverage alongside conditional feasible gaps.
analysis.secondary: B-A, C-A paired deltas; comparisons against fixed rules, random candidate, NN, NN+2opt; heterogeneous graph results and choice/candidate collapse.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive seven-graph results; no treating 63 trajectories as independent samples and no significance cherry-picking.
analysis.unit: Seven original graphs; average 3 relabel/start conditions within graph. Random seeds average within condition first.

interpretation: Restricting choices to hand-designed append proposals accounts for a large improvement over full-action A; even uniform random candidate selection beats all three full-action A graph-macro gaps.
Adding rule semantics and mapping in C improves the paired graph-macro result versus anonymous B for all three models, with heterogeneous graph-level changes and one incomplete Jev B condition.

No model arm beats the single executable frozen return_reserve rule on graph-macro gap. No model arm approaches nearest-neighbor plus 2-opt. Do not attribute external heuristic quality to model planning.
Qwen9 C is close to nearest neighbor (26.7607 versus 27.6453 percent); Jev C is also close (27.7985). These descriptive seven-graph differences do not establish solver superiority.
Approximately 44 to 48 percent of observed append steps have only one unique proposal and are forced, so the methods do not have matched model-call counts.

Option-position concentration is substantial despite per-step shuffled candidate mappings: Qwen4 B selects option 1 in 1303/1596 calls; Qwen9 B selects option 0 in 1240/1629 calls. C reduces these shares to 1036/1646 and 988/1548, respectively. These are descriptive position counts, not causal or significance claims.
Four new Jev successful calls have invalid probability sums; native actions were retained, with no normalization or argmax substitution. The sole failed call remains in the denominator.
boundaries: Seven original graphs, with three correlated relabel/start conditions each; not 63 independent samples.
B and C match graph, candidates, numeric features, ordering and city actions only conditional on the same history. Their subsequent trajectories differ.
C adds semantic labels/formulas/mapping and prompt content; this does not isolate planning ability.
Gap summaries are conditional on completed tours. Jev B has one missing condition; paired C-B delta uses jointly complete conditions, not naive subtraction of marginal means.
Legacy A wall time includes replay, so its true solve-only wall is unavailable. Report A legacy wall/API time separately; do not claim a clean solve-only A-versus-B/C speedup.
The best fixed rule is a reported baseline result, not a posthoc executable oracle selector.
publication_note: CSV exports retain original precision. Raw graphs, model request logs and private local paths are not redistributed. Published code provenance is portable; original frozen experiment sources and seals were not changed.
csv_line_endings: LF; normalized from original CSV exports without changing any cells.
